_doc: THE single source of truth for media sources in Cloud Media Center. Kotlin (once patched into the ReFra fork) iterates `profiles` at runtime to populate the source picker / Album list — a hardcoded source list in Kotlin is FORBIDDEN (FIRE rule 6). Every profile presents the SAME Album/MediaItem model to the UI regardless of source_type; only the fetch/sync backend differs. No secrets live here — auth material is a sops/vault reference BY NAME ONLY, never a literal value.
_doc_product: This app is a Google-Photos / Samsung-Gallery replacement. 'local' is the Samsung-Gallery half (on-device gallery); 'photoprism' is the Google-Photos half (cloud library + auto-backup), backed by the ALREADY-DEPLOYED user-media_photoprism service. 'youtube' is our addition on top of what those apps do.

local._doc: Upstream ReFra's own MediaStore scanner — UNCHANGED code path. No config needed beyond enabling the profile.

photoprism._doc: The cloud library, served by the deployed user-media_photoprism service (oci-apps, container port 3013). PhotoPrism exposes WebDAV at /originals/ (read the library) and /import/ (write; PhotoPrism AUTO-INDEXES whatever lands there) — that /import/ PUT is exactly the Google-Photos auto-backup mechanism. Auth is a PhotoPrism app password (`photoprism auth add --scope webdav`), NOT the account password, referenced here only by its sops key name. NOTE: upstream ReFra already ships an ownCloud provider, which is WebDAV — the open question (see README ## Spike) is whether that provider does UPLOAD or is read-only. That answer decides whether backup is a config change or a real patch.

newpipe._doc: com.github.teamnewpipe:NewPipeExtractor (GPL-3.0, resolved via JitPack — the reason this whole app is GPL-3.0, see build.json::license). YouTube ONLY per current scope decision. 'feeds' lists what to pull (channel/playlist ids); empty feeds = source enabled but nothing subscribed yet.

profiles.label: Cloud (PhotoPrism)
profiles._doc_base_url: VERIFIED from user-media_photoprism/build.json::domain (service on oci-apps, container port 3013).
profiles._doc_webdav_write_path: Uploads PUT here; PhotoPrism indexes automatically. Do NOT write into /originals/ directly — that bypasses indexing. BLOCKED TODAY: see _blockers below, the import dir is not mounted and originals is read-only.
profiles._doc_auth_secret_ref: UNRESOLVED — sops key NAME of the PhotoPrism WebDAV app password (create with `photoprism auth add --scope webdav`). A NAME ONLY. Never put the password itself in this file (FIRE rule 7A/7B).
profiles._doc_wg_only: CHANGING to true per user instruction: the route is being moved from public+Authelia-2FA to WG-only (gated to the WG mesh, 10.0.0.0/24). A parallel agent is making this change in the cloud repo (user-media_photoprism/build.json) right now. WG-gating is expected to remove the Authelia-intercepts-WebDAV problem below, but whether `wg_only` actually bypasses Authelia in this fleet's Caddy deriver is PENDING VERIFICATION by that agent — treat as unverified until confirmed.

_blockers._doc: Three blockers stand between here and a working backup. The first two are VERIFIED and need a change to user-media_photoprism (cloud repo) BEFORE any backup code is written. Do not write the SyncWorker until all three are cleared.
_blockers.originals_read_only: user-media_photoprism/build.json mounts `/opt/containers/photoprism/originals:/photoprism/originals:ro` — READ-ONLY. WebDAV writes to /originals/ will fail. The dir is an rclone mount of the `my-photos` OCI bucket, so PhotoPrism is currently a read-only viewer over object storage.
_blockers.no_import_mount: There is NO import volume in the compose at all — only photoprism_storage and the read-only originals. /import/ does not exist on disk, so nothing can be uploaded into it.
_blockers.authelia_2fa_in_front: CHOSEN FIX, PENDING VERIFICATION: the route is moving to `wg_only: true` instead of `auth: two_factor`, so a WebDAV client on the WG mesh should bypass the interactive Authelia flow entirely. Whether this fleet's Caddy deriver actually skips Authelia for wg_only routes is being verified by a parallel agent right now — do not assume this is fixed until that lands.

backup._doc: The Google-Photos auto-backup behaviour. Off by default: turning it on starts uploading the user's camera roll, which must be a deliberate choice, not a scaffold default.

profiles.label: Instagram (mirrored)
profiles._doc: Instagram is deliberately NOT a first-class app source — there is NO Instagram SDK/API/session-cookie integration in this app at all, and none is planned. A server-side gallery-dl job mirrors the account's OWN PUBLIC posts (no session cookie, no private-content scraping — decided scope) into PhotoPrism's import folder; PhotoPrism indexes them into an album. From the app's point of view this is just the PhotoPrism source pointed at a sub-path. Adding another mirrored network later = one more entry here plus one more gallery-dl job. No APK rebuild, no Kotlin.
profiles._doc_webdav_write_path: null — read-only. The app never writes to the mirror.

profiles.label: YouTube
profiles._doc_feeds: Array of {kind, id} objects the app subscribes to via NewPipeExtractor, e.g. {"kind": "channel", "id": "UC..."} or {"kind": "playlist", "id": "PL..."}. Empty = source available in the picker but nothing subscribed; populate through in-app UI (not this file) once the newpipe patch series exists.
